control_objective: New hire accounts are created only through an approved request, with evidence of who requested and who approved the access.
test_procedure: For a sample of new hires in the audit period, obtain the provisioning record and confirm a named requester, a named approver, and that approval predates or coincides with account creation.
sample_size_and_method: 25 judgmental sample of active hires from the audit period (population 210 active hires within the period; 25 is the conventional ITGC sample size for populations under 250).
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all 25 sampled records show a documented requester and approver predating account creation. Any sample item missing either is a control exception.
evidence_expected: Provisioning tickets (01-provisioning/) cross-referenced to user-population.csv by employee_id.

control_objective: New hire access is limited to the baseline appropriate for their role at the time of hire (license tier, department group, no unrequested elevated access).
test_procedure: For the same sample as PROV-01, compare the access actually granted (license type, any elevated role) against the baseline defined for that job title in identity-environment.md.
sample_size_and_method: Same 25-item sample as PROV-01, tested jointly.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if granted access matches the documented baseline for the role. A new hire granted access beyond baseline without a separate, approved justification is a control exception.
evidence_expected: Provisioning tickets, user-population.csv, privileged-accounts.csv (for any sampled hire who also appears on the privileged roster).

control_objective: Entra ID accounts are disabled promptly after termination, consistent with the documented process (same day to a short grace period).
test_procedure: Test the full population of terminations in the audit period. Calculate the gap between termination_date and account_disabled_date for each.
sample_size_and_method: All 25 terminated employees in user-population.csv (population is small enough to test 100% rather than sample).
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if disabled within 3 business days of termination. A longer gap is a timeliness exception; no disablement at all is treated separately under DEPROV-02.

control_objective: No terminated employee retains an enabled account as of the audit date (orphaned access).
test_procedure: Test the full population of terminations in the audit period. Flag any record where account_status is still Enabled.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if zero terminated employees show account_status = Enabled as of the audit date. Any such record is a control exception, treated as high severity.

control_objective: Standing privileged (tenant-wide admin) access is limited to named accounts with a documented business justification, reviewed on a defined cadence.
test_procedure: Test the full privileged account roster. Confirm each standing Global Administrator (or other tenant-wide role) has a documented justification and a last_access_review_date within the policy's quarterly window.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if every standing privileged account has a documented justification and a review on file within the last quarter. Missing justification or a stale/absent review is a control exception.

control_objective: All privileged accounts enforce multi-factor authentication, with break-glass accounts handled through the documented exception process rather than ad hoc exclusion.
test_procedure: Test the full privileged account roster. Confirm mfa_enrolled = Yes for every standing account, and that only the two named break-glass accounts are excluded from Conditional Access.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if every standing privileged account enforces MFA and the only Conditional Access exclusions are the two documented break-glass accounts. Any other excluded or non-MFA standing account is a control exception.

control_objective: Break-glass emergency access accounts are tested and their credentials rotated on the documented quarterly cadence.
test_procedure: Review the last_access_review_date (used here as the last successful test date) for each of the two break-glass accounts against the quarterly cadence in identity-environment.md.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if both accounts show a successful test within the trailing 3 months of the audit date. A lapsed test is a control exception.

control_objective: Active users are enrolled in multi-factor authentication consistent with Conditional Access policy CA01 (require MFA for all users).
test_procedure: Test the full active user population. Calculate the proportion with mfa_enrolled = Yes and list every exception by name and department.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if MFA coverage is effectively complete (treated here as 98%+, allowing for a small number of accounts in a documented exception or onboarding grace period). Coverage below that threshold, or any exception without a documented reason, is a control exception.

control_objective: Legacy (non-modern) authentication is blocked tenant-wide per Conditional Access policy CA02, with no standing exceptions.
test_procedure: Review the service account inventory and any available authentication-method configuration for accounts still permitting legacy protocols.
sample_size_and_method: All 6 accounts in service-accounts.csv, plus the privileged and user populations as a secondary check.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if no account in any population permits legacy authentication. Any account found to allow it is a control exception, regardless of account type.

control_objective: Privileged role assignments are reviewed on the documented quarterly cadence, with evidence the review was performed and acted on.
test_procedure: Test the full privileged roster's last_access_review_date against the quarterly cadence, consistent with PAM-01 but reported as its own control since access review and privileged access management are distinct obligations.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all accounts show a review within the trailing quarter. Reported jointly with PAM-01's underlying data but assessed as a separate control per the audit scope.

control_objective: Standard user access is reviewed at least annually, with evidence the review was performed and any unneeded access removed.
test_procedure: For a sample of active users, obtain evidence of the most recent annual access review and confirm it occurred within the last 12 months.
sample_size_and_method: 25 judgmental sample of active users, stratified to include at least 2 from each department where possible.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all 25 sampled users have evidence of a review within the last 12 months. Absence of any review evidence for a sampled user is a control exception.
evidence_expected: Access review evidence (05-access-reviews/) cross-referenced to user-population.csv.

control_objective: Internal transfers and promotions trigger a re-evaluation of access, removing access tied to the prior role rather than accumulating it alongside new access.
test_procedure: For a sample of employees who changed department or role during the audit period, compare access before and after the change.
sample_size_and_method: 10 judgmental sample of internal movers identified during testing (exact population of movers is not known until the HR change log is reviewed).
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if sampled movers show access consistent with their current role only. Retained access tied to a prior role is a control exception (access creep).

control_objective: Manager-of-record changes in the HR system are reflected accurately and promptly in Entra ID.
test_procedure: For the same mover sample as JML-01, confirm the manager_username field was updated to reflect the new reporting line within a reasonable timeframe of the change.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if manager_username reflects the current reporting line for all sampled movers. A stale manager assignment is a control exception.
evidence_expected: Mover records cross-referenced to user-population.csv (manager_username field).

control_objective: Changes to Conditional Access policies and standing privileged role assignments follow a documented change management process (request, approval, test, record).
test_procedure: For a sample of changes made to Conditional Access policy or privileged role membership during the audit period, obtain the change record and confirm it was requested, approved, and logged before being put into effect.
sample_size_and_method: 10 judgmental sample of access-related changes identified during testing.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if all 10 sampled changes show a complete, approved change record predating implementation. A missing or incomplete record is a control exception.
